notes.title: July 26 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]This week's updates are as follows:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078103/6bbb5965a2313abe96f96a65da4f3454a7d6895d.gif[/img]

This week's updates are as follows:
1.Command Activation: You can now use the keyword "open" to open any file or folder on your desktop (including contents within folders), as well as launch any installed program.
a) Example: Typing "open NetEase Cloud" will open NetEase Cloud Music.

2.Command Search: You can now use the keyword "web search" to quickly search for any content online.
a) Example: Using “command search” to search Crayon Shin-chan" will open the default browser and search for Crayon Shin-chan.

3.Appear/Hide: You can now use the keyword "hide" or the right-click menu to hide, or drag characters to the edge of the screen to hide them. Characters can be unhidden by right-clicking or dragging them back.

4.Upload Preview: When uploading models, you can now preview their actions and configure movements more conveniently.

5.Layout Mode: When configuring settings, you can adjust the size and position of models, overall layout size, bubble and input box positions. You can also adjust where the model's probe extends in hide mode, allowing for more customized desktop pet layouts.

6.New Voices: We've added 6 new voice options in this update, enriching our voice library.

notes.title: 本次更新开放了"创意工坊"功能，首个阶段用户可以自由DIY定制角色
notes.content:
优化内容
1.托盘模式，隐藏了任务栏
2.使用鼠标滑轮可以快速的调整模型放大缩小
3.模型会保证各种屏幕布局的情况下都不能移出屏幕，托盘右键可以快速调整层级和让模型复位5分钟前德斌
